title: Implement supervised lifecycle and health state machine
objective: Implement probe-before-spawn, direct foreground launch, readiness, resume invalidation, classifier, and fixed retry thresholds.
output_format: Windows-tagged Go adapters, platform-neutral policy where possible, fake-clock tests, fidelity backstops, and invariant tests.
tool_guidance: Use injected WSLRunner, HostControl, HealthProber, Clock, Timer, and ResumeSource seams.
task_boundaries: Own lifecycle, launch, health, retry, resume, and generation policy; exclude SCM stop escalation and recording retention.
acceptance: No spawn occurs before determinate absence.
decision_closure_reason: Launch topology, adoption classifier, retry thresholds, readiness, resume handling, and shutdown budget are fixed by accepted ADRs.
